quantra_CommodityPeriod.description: One calculation period. Both dates are included.

start_date.description: First day of the period, included (YYYY-MM-DD). Required.

end_date.description:
Last day of the period, included (YYYY-MM-DD). On or after
`start_date` (400 otherwise). Required.

quantra_CommodityPeriods.description:
The calculation periods of a commodity leg, in one of two forms; exactly
one is given (400 otherwise, including a mix of the two):
generated: `start_date`, `end_date` and `frequency` all present, no
`periods`;
explicit: only `periods`.
Dates are never adjusted for weekends or holidays: a period's pricing
days are read inside it from the pricing calendar.
Generated periods are calendar months, quarters, half-years or years
(`frequency` Monthly, Quarterly, Semiannual, Annual), the first period
cut to start at `start_date` and the last cut to end at `end_date`.
Example: 2026-11-15 to 2027-03-31 Monthly gives 15-30 November, December,
January, February and March. `Once` gives one period from `start_date` to
`end_date`. Any other frequency is a 400.

start_date.description: Generated form: first day of the first period, included (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Generated form: last day of the last period, included (YYYY-MM-DD).

frequency.description: Generated form: Monthly, Quarterly, Semiannual, Annual or Once.

periods.description:
Explicit form: the periods in ascending order. They must not overlap;
gaps between them are allowed.

quantra_CommodityContractMonth.description:
One delivery month of a futures contract with its last trading date and
today's price.

last_trade_date.description:
Last trading date of this contract month (YYYY-MM-DD). The contract
is read as the nearby contract up to and including this date,
shifted by the leg's `roll_days_before_expiry`. Required.

price.description:
Today's futures price of this month. Needed only for months read
after the valuation date; absent for months whose pricing days are all
in the past.

quantra_CommodityContractFixing.description: A past daily settlement of one contract month.

month.description: Delivery month the settlement belongs to, "YYYY-MM". Required.

value.description:
Settlement price, as quoted. Presence-required: an omitted value is a
400, never a silent 0.

quantra_CommodityContractSpec.description:
A futures contract and its delivery months. Registered once per request,
referenced by id from `FuturesFloatingPrice.contract_id`.

pricing_calendar.description:
Calendar of the contract's pricing days: the days the contract
settles. Adjusted by `pricing.calendar_overrides`. Presence-required.

pricing_holidays.description:
Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) that are not pricing days of this contract,
applied on top of `pricing_calendar` and of
`pricing.calendar_overrides`. They affect no other use of that
calendar in the request. This is how an exchange's own holidays are
given when the named calendar differs from the exchange's.

months.description:
The delivery months in ascending order, with last trading dates and
today's prices. `FuturesFloatingPrice.nearby` counts through this
list, so a missing month makes a later month the nearby one.
Required.

fixings.description:
Past settlements of the contract's months. A pricing day before the
valuation date needs a fixing (a missing one is a 400); on the
valuation date the fixing is used when given, otherwise today's
price.

quantra_CommoditySpotFixing.description: A past published price of a spot assessment.

value.description:
Published price, as quoted. Presence-required: an omitted value is a
400, never a silent 0.

quantra_CommoditySpotPoint.description: One forward price of a spot assessment.

date.description: Date the price applies to (YYYY-MM-DD). Required.

price.description:
Forward price for that date, as quoted.
Presence-required.

quantra_CommoditySpotSpec.description:
A spot price assessment (for example a published daily price) with its
forward prices by date. Registered once per request, referenced by id
from `SpotFloatingPrice.spot_id`.

pricing_calendar.description:
Calendar of the pricing days: the days the price is published.
Adjusted by `pricing.calendar_overrides`. Presence-required.

pricing_holidays.description:
Dates (YYYY-MM-DD) that are not pricing days of this spot price,
applied on top of `pricing_calendar` and of
`pricing.calendar_overrides`. They affect no other use of that
calendar in the request. This is how an exchange's own holidays are
given when the named calendar differs from the exchange's.

interpolation.description:
How the forward prices are interpolated between dates: Linear,
BackwardFlat or ForwardFlat. LogLinear and LogCubic are a 400
(prices can be zero or negative). Presence-required.

extrapolate_flat.description:
When false, a pricing day before the first point or after the last
point is a 400; when true the first price is held flat before the
first point and the last price after the last point.

points.description: Forward prices by date, in ascending date order. Required.

fixings.description:
Past published prices. A pricing day before the valuation date needs
a fixing (a missing one is a 400); on the valuation date the fixing
is used when given, otherwise today's price.

quantra_CommodityAverageQuote.description:
An average-price quote: the fixed price of a fixed-for-floating average
swap on the contract (fixed paid, the average of the `nearby` contract
month over each period's pricing days received) that is worth zero. It
is one equation on the prices of the months it reads:
quote = constant + sum of weight x month price, where the constant is the
part already fixed (fixings) and the weights are the pricing days reading
each month, times the period's quantity and discount factor, divided by
the sum of quantity x discount factor over the periods still to be paid.

periods.description:
The quote's calculation periods, as on a swap leg (generated or
explicit). One period (a month, or a quarter settled once) or several
(a quarter or a calendar year settled per month). Required.

nearby.description:
The contract month averaged, as on `FuturesFloatingPrice`: 1 = front
month. Contract builds: presence-required, >= 1. Spot builds: not
given (400).

roll_days_before_expiry.description:
Roll this many pricing days before the last trading date, as on
`FuturesFloatingPrice`. Contract builds: presence-required, >= 0.
Spot builds: not given (400).

quantity_basis.description:
PerPeriod (each period weighs the same) or PerPricingDay (each period
weighs its pricing days). Required with more than one period; one
period: optional (it changes nothing).

payment_calendar.description:
Payment of each period, as on a swap leg: `payment_lag` business days
of `payment_calendar` after the period's last day, adjusted with
`payment_convention`. Required with more than one period; one period:
optional (the discount factor cancels), used when given.

discounting_curve.description:
Id of a `pricing.rates.curves` curve discounting the payments (404
when unknown). Required with more than one period; one period:
optional.

versus_base.description:
Basis builds only: when true, `price` is a spread, the average of this
curve over the periods minus the average of the base over the same
periods (each with the quote's quantities, payments and discounting:
the difference of the two fair fixed prices). Default false.

base_nearby.description:
With `versus_base` on a contract build: the base contract month
averaged and its roll, as `nearby` / `roll_days_before_expiry` are for
this contract. Required then; refused otherwise (and on spot builds).

quantra_CommodityBasisQuote.description:
One basis quote: the month's (point's) price is its base price plus
`value`.

month.description:
Contract builds: a month of the contract being built, "YYYY-MM".
Required there; refused on spot builds.

value.description:
The basis, added to the base price (a caller quoting base minus
basis sends the negated value). Presence-required.

date.description:
Spot builds: the date of one of the spot's points (YYYY-MM-DD).
Required there; refused on contract builds.

quantra_CommodityCurveBasis.description:
A contract (or spot price) priced as another contract (spot price) of the
request, the base, plus a basis.

base.description:
The id of another entry of the same kind (a contract build for a
contract, a spot build for a spot price), built first whatever the
order (404 when no entry has that id). A fully priced entry is how a
finished base is given. Required.

base_price.description:
Contract builds: how the base price of a month is read, SameMonth or
MonthAverage. Presence-required there; refused on spot builds (a
point's base price is the base spot read on the point's date).

base_month_offset.description:
SameMonth: the base month is the basis month minus this many months
(>= 0). Not used with MonthAverage.

base_nearby.description:
MonthAverage: the base contract month averaged and its roll, as on a
swap leg. Required with MonthAverage, refused with SameMonth.

quotes.description:
The basis quotes. A quoted month gets base + value as its price
(source Basis); a month with both a price and a basis quote, or a
basis quote on an expired month, is a 400.

quantra_CommodityCurveBuild.description:
One futures contract or spot price to build: the months (points) that
have a price are quotes, the average quotes are equations on the months
(points) they read, and the ones no quote touches are filled.

contract.description:
The contract as `pricing.commodity.contracts[]` of a swap request
takes it. A month with a `price` is a quote and is returned
unchanged. A live month (last trading date on or after the valuation
date) without a price is solved from the average quotes when one of
them reads it, otherwise filled with `interpolation`. A month whose
last trading date is before the valuation date is returned as sent
(it is read through fixings). Fixings, pricing calendar and pricing
holidays are returned unchanged. Exactly one of `contract` and `spot`
is given (400 otherwise).

interpolation.description:
How a live month no quote touches is filled from the determined
months (quoted, solved or assumed): Linear, LogLinear, BackwardFlat,
ForwardFlat, KrugerCubic or NaturalCubic (see
`CommodityCurveInterpolation`), on the axis of their last trading
dates in calendar days from the valuation date / 365. Required as soon
as such a month exists.

extrapolate_flat.description:
When false, a live month no quote touches before the first determined
month or after the last one is a 400 naming the month; when true it
takes the price of the nearest determined month, whatever the method
(a method is never continued beyond the determined months).

average_quotes.description:
Average-price quotes, solved together with the month prices as one
linear system. Optional.

rule.description:
Required when the quotes do not determine every month they touch
(400 listing those months otherwise): Flat or Smooth. When they do,
it is validated and echoed and changes nothing.

spot.description:
A spot price to build instead of a contract, as
`pricing.commodity.spot_prices[]` of a swap request takes it. Its
`points` are the nodes, at the dates the caller chose: a point with a
`price` is a quote and is returned unchanged, a point without one is
solved from the average quotes that read it or, when none does, read
from the determined points with the spot's own `interpolation` and
`extrapolate_flat`. The average quotes average the spot price (no
`nearby` / `roll_days_before_expiry`); `interpolation` above is not
given (400). Exactly one of `contract` and `spot`.

basis.description:
The contract (spot price) is a basis to another contract (spot price)
of the request. The live months (points) no quote touches are then
filled on their basis (price - base price) with the interpolation and
extrapolate_flat of the build, and the base price is added back.

quantra_CommodityMarketData.description: Commodity market data grouped under the shared Pricing context.

contracts.description: Futures contracts referenced by commodity swap legs.

spot_prices.description: Spot price assessments referenced by commodity swap legs.

curve_builds.description:
Contracts and spot prices built in the request from quotes, exactly
as `/build-commodity-curves` builds `curves` (same entries, same
rules, `include_details` not read), then registered under their ids
next to `contracts` and `spot_prices`. An id given twice across the
three lists is a 400. A basis entry's base is another entry of this
list.

quantra_CommodityQuoteSensitivity.description:
The sensitivity of a month price to one input quote: a direct price
(`month`) or an average quote (`average_quote`, its index).

month.description: Month of a direct price ("YYYY-MM"). Absent for an average quote.

average_quote.description:
Index of an average quote in `average_quotes`. Absent for a direct
price.

date.description: Date of a direct spot point price (YYYY-MM-DD), instead of `month`.

curve.description:
Basis builds: the index in `curves` of the entry the input belongs
to, when it is an input of the base (or of the base's base). Absent
for the entry's own inputs.

quantra_CommodityCurveMonth.description: One live month of the built contract.

sensitivities.description:
With `include_details`, Quoted / Solved / Assumed months: one entry
per input quote (direct prices in month order, then average quotes).

base_price.description:
Basis builds: the month's base price and its basis (price - base
price). Absent otherwise.

quantra_CommodityQuoteWeight.description: The weight of one month (or spot point) in an average quote's equation.

date.description: The spot point's date (YYYY-MM-DD). Absent for a month.

quantra_CommodityCurvePoint.description: One point of a built spot price.

sensitivities.description:
With `include_details`, Quoted / Solved / Assumed points: one entry
per input quote (direct point prices in date order, then average
quotes).

base_price.description:
Basis builds: the point's base price (the base spot read on its date)
and price - base price.

quantra_CommodityAverageQuoteResult.description: One average quote after the build.

repriced.description: The quote's fair fixed price on the built contract, priced as a swap.

weights.description:
With `include_details`: the quote's equation,
quoted = constant + sum of weight x month price.

rule.description: The rule sent (echo); absent when none was sent.

unknowns.description:
Months the quotes touch, equations (direct prices plus average
quotes) and the number of independent equations.

max_repricing_difference.description: Largest |difference| over the average quotes (0 without any).

months.description:
Contract builds: every live month in contract order. Absent for a
spot build.

average_quotes.description: Every average quote in request order.

max_sensitivity.description:
With `include_details`: the largest absolute sensitivity of a month
price to a quote. A large value means a small change of a quote moves
some month a lot: the build is fragile.

points.description: Spot builds: every point in date order.

contract.description:
The request's contract with every live month priced: quoted months,
expired months, fixings, pricing calendar and pricing holidays as
sent. Pastes unchanged into `pricing.commodity.contracts` of a
`/price-commodity-swap` request. Present for a contract build.

spot.description:
The request's spot price with every point priced: interpolation,
extrapolate_flat, fixings, pricing calendar and pricing holidays as
sent. Pastes unchanged into `pricing.commodity.spot_prices` of a
`/price-commodity-swap` request. Present for a spot build.

quantra_BuildCommodityCurvesResponse.description: Response for all requested contracts, in request order.
